title: 女の子・キャラクターのぬりえ
subject_en: Coloring pages of original cute girl characters, each ONE character full body or waist up, centred, drawn with thick clean closed black outlines only and NOTHING filled in: the inside of every shape stays plain white. Friendly simple faces. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: ドレス、制服、ようふく、お祭りなど、いろいろな女の子の塗り絵12点。線は太くはっきりしていて、印刷して子どもと楽しめます。
